en.summary: Trigger finger causes clicking, catching or locking of a finger. NHS: rest, splints, and clinician-led injections/surgery if needed — never invent steroid doses. Emergency: rapidly spreading hand infection, fever with red streaking, or trauma with deformity.
emergencyIf: Spreading redness with fever after injection/injury
Hand trauma with deformity or numbness
seeDoctorIf: Finger locking that interferes with grip
Painful nodule at the base of a finger
doNot: Do not invent steroid injection doses

fr.summary: Doigt à ressaut: blocage/clic. Urgences si infection diffuse ou traumatisme. Pas de posologies inventées.

he.summary: אצבע הדק: נעילה/נקישה. חירום בזיהום מתפשט או חבלה. אין מינונים מומצאים.

ru.summary: Щёлкающий палец: блокировка/щелчок. Неотложка при инфекции или травме. Дозы не выдумывать.
